Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_11430_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: rtlpp_11430_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11430(data_out, empty, full, data_in, push, pop, reset, clk);
	
	parameter DEPTH = 8;			
	parameter WIDTH = 8;
	
	output reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_out; 
	output reg empty;
	output reg full;

	input [WIDTH-1:0] data_in;
	input push;
	input pop;
	input reset;
	input clk;

	reg [DEPTH-1:0] wraddr, rdaddr;
	reg [WIDTH-1:0] reg_file [DEPTH-1:0];
	reg [DEPTH-1:0] num_elems;
	
	always @(posedge reset)
	begin
		data_out <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
		empty <= 1'b1;
		full <= 1'b0;
		wraddr <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
		rdaddr <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
		num_elems <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
	end
	
	always @(posedge clk)
	begin
		if(push && (~full) && (~pop))
		begin
			reg_file[wraddr] <= data_in;
			wraddr <= (wraddr + 1) % DEPTH;
			num_elems <= num_elems + 1;
			
			if(empty)
				empty <= 1'b0;

			if((wraddr == rdaddr) && (~empty) && (num_elems == DEPTH))
				full <= 1'b1;
			else
				full <= 1'b0;
		end
		else if(pop && (~empty) && (~push))
		begin
			data_out <= reg_file[rdaddr];
			rdaddr <= (rdaddr + 1) % DEPTH;
			num_elems <= num_elems - 1;
			
			if(full)
				full <= 1'b0;

			if(wraddr == rdaddr)
				empty <= 1'b1;
			else
				empty <= 1'b0;
		end

	end
	
endmodule
